title: Triplanar box-projected image material
purpose: Build an image material that needs no UV map: object coordinates scaled to a texture size in metres feed an Image Texture in box projection with a soft blend, using a given image or a generated UV grid. Use it for scanned or generated meshes, kitbash parts and blockouts.

parameters.name: image_path
parameters.description: Image file to project; empty generates a UV grid image.

parameters.name: texture_size
parameters.description: World size of one repeat of the image.

parameters.name: blend
parameters.description: Width of the soft blend between the three projections.

parameters.name: grid_resolution
parameters.description: Side of the generated grid image when no path is given.

parameters.name: assign
parameters.description: Assign the material to the active object.

outputs.description: One material with a box-projected image; assigned to the active object.

limits: Box projection follows object axes, so rotating the object rotates the projection with it and curved surfaces show stretching in the blend zones. Normal maps are not projected; this is a colour texture tool. The generated grid is for judging scale and seams, not final look. Rendered here with Cycles CPU only. Verified in Blender 5.2.1; written for the 4.2 API.
technique_references: Box (triplanar) projection of an image along the three object axes
Texture size in metres by scaling object coordinates
